import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

public class BasicJava
{
   public static void main(String[] args)
   {
      Task Main = new Task();
      Main.solve();
   }

      public PrintWriter out;
      
      public Task() {
         in = new InputReader(System.in);
         out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
      }
      
      public void solve()
      {
         int w = in.nextInt();
         int m = in.nextInt();
         
         int[] t = new int[110];
         int nr = 0;
         
         while (m > 0) {
            nr++;
            t[nr] = m % w;
            m /= w;
         }
         
         for (int i = 1; i <= nr; i++) {
            if (t[i] > w / 2) {
               t[i] = -(t[i] - w);
               t[i + 1]++;
            }
         }
         
         if (t[nr] == 1) nr++;
         
         for (int i = 1; i <= nr; i++) {
            if (t[i] > 1) {
               System.out.println("NO");
               System.exit(0);
            }
         }
         
         System.out.println("YES");
      }
   }

            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
         }
         return buf[curChar];
      }

         while (x-- > 0) read();
      }

         StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
         do { res.appendCodePoint(c); c = read(); }
         while (!isSpaceChar(c));
